title: Dont do habits
body: Only missing thing why I havent yet bought premium is that there are no auto count habits - e.g. no smoking habit which increases by 1 (or custom number) every day, but when you complete it (break habit), counter is set to 0 again. You could also add money saved per day, but this is something optional.
author: Mujo32145
